spans.s:
m. (-मः)
Burnt-offering, the casting of clarified butter, &c. into the sacred fire, as an offering to the gods, accompanied with prayers or invocations, according to the object of the sacrifice.
E.
हु to sacrifice, मन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-ण्डं)
A hole in the ground or an altar, for receiving the fire for an oblation.
E.
होम burnt-offering, and कुण्ड a hole.

m. (-मः)
The smoke of burnt-offering.
E.
होम as above, and धूम smoke.

n. (-स्म)
The ashes of a burnt-offering.
E.
होम as above, भस्मन् ashes.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having performed sacrifice.
E.
होम, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-ग्निः)
Sacrificial fire.
E.
होम an oblation, and अग्नि fire.

Water.
E.
हु to sacrifice, मिन् aff.

m. (-मी)
The offerer of an oblation.
E.
हु to sacrifice, मिनि Uṇādi aff.
